questions.question: Which scene makes a single, unique window you open by id?
Where should every important action in a Mac app be?

answers.text: In a menu, with a shortcut for the common ones

questions.why: The menu bar is how Mac users discover and repeat actions.

questions.question: What does the App Sandbox do?

answers.text: Limits the app to its own container and the abilities it asks for

questions.why: It protects people from apps that overreach.
